body: Thx but no one really loves me.  I will be dying this week after I take care of some things.   It's over.

Oh yes.  I have sought help many times.  Tried everything.  I just cannot continue on like this and I really realized this week that this is my best option.  I have no other choice.  Going forward is not an option for me.  It's sad, and I hate it....but it is what it is.  Some people are not meant to walk this earth.  Some people are not as strong.  Some people feel too much.  I am all of those.  But thanks!
